benchmark_semantics: Full 3x4x2x2 factorial Research/IRB state space under the already frozen deterministic institutional oracle.
future_training_protocol: For outer fold k, fit only on states whose outer_fold != k plus the frozen original Gate-21A TRAIN partition. Hyperparameters are selected using the frozen Gate-21A DEV partition only. Evaluate once on outer fold k.
aggregate_evaluation: Pool predictions from all four held-out folds after each record has served as test exactly once. Report pooled accuracy, macro-F1, per-class metrics, confusion matrix and policy-inconsistent execution.
overfitting_controls: protocol frozen before Gate-23G repair training
each factorial signature belongs to exactly one outer test fold
outer test fold excluded from fitting and hyperparameter selection
same frozen oracle and feature semantics used across folds
interaction_learnability_rule: Any engineered interaction activated in an outer test fold must have nonzero positive support on that fold's training side.
claim_boundary: This is a prospective combinatorial generalization benchmark over a synthetic policy state space. It is not an external clinical dataset and must not be described as externally unseen real-world data.
